sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search?q=willow%20creek (no individual-site campground facility; only WILLOW CREEK GROUP 233941)

values.note: 32 non-electric single sites per the campground page (the forest's status table says 35) plus one group site for tents (up to 20 people) and double sites. The forest's Campground Status table gives a 25-ft maximum spur against the page's 40 ft. Vehicles must fit the parking spur; no driving or parking off road.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/willow-creek-campground ('There are 32 non-electric sites that will accommodate tents, trailers and RVs. There is also one group site that will accommodate tents and can hold up to 20 people.'; 'RVs, trailers or other vehicles must fit on the parking spur. Driving or parking off road is not permitted. Maximum Vehicle Length: 40'.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Sulphur Ranger District Campground Status: 'Willow Creek | 35, single | 1, group up to 20 people | 25’'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water, but availability varies, especially early and late in the season: bring your own. Trash service, boat ramp; some sites have a bear locker.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/willow-creek-campground ('Other facilities included restrooms, trash service, drinking water and a boat ramp.'; 'Some campsites have a bear locker.'; 'Restrooms: Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('Water availability varies, especially at the beginning and end of the campground season. Be sure to bring adequate water for you needs.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Single site $29, double $58, group $116 (1-20 people). The Arapaho National Recreation Area pass is also required ($5 a day, $10 three days, $15 a week, $30 a year per recreation.gov).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/willow-creek-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night | Double Site: $58 per night | Group Site: $116 per night (1-20 people)') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('$29/58 | $116* ... Arapaho National Recreation fee applies.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233941 ('An additional fee will be charged for admission to the Arapaho National Recreation Area; fees are $5 a day, $10 for three days, $15 per week or $30 per year'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Campground dates are set annually and will not be extended.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Sulphur Ranger District Campground Status, Willow Creek, Operating Season 'May 15 - Sept 20'; 'Campground dates are set annually and will not be extended.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Individual sites are first come, first served; only the group site is reservable (recreation.gov 'Willow Creek Group').

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('First-come, first-served; reservable group site') + recreation.gov search (only facility 233941 'WILLOW CREEK GROUP'), read 2026-10-28

note: In the Arapaho National Recreation Area at ~8,130 ft on the south shore of Willow Creek Reservoir (no-wake), three miles west of US-34 on County Road 40, north of Granby. Lodgepole loop on a point beside the boat ramp; sites sit back in the trees from the shore. Narrow single-lane dam access. --Claude
summary: FS campground page + ARP Campground Status table: confirmed 32 sites (status table 35), vault toilets, $29, FCFS (group site alone reservable on recreation.gov); changed potable_water false -> true (page: drinking water available, varies early/late), added max 40 (page; status table 25), season May 15 - Sept 20. Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Website: stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation is the forest's recreation index. Use the campground's own page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/willow-creek-campground.

Phone: none stored. Neither the campground page nor the Sulphur Ranger District page prints a district number; ARP gives 970-295-6600 (Supervisor's Office, Fort Collins) on every page, which earlier batches found is the number ARP now uses for all its offices. The long-standing Sulphur RD line 970-887-4100 appears on no FS page read. Suggest 970-295-6600, or leave blank.

Length conflict: the campground page (and recreation.gov's group listing) 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 40'' vs the forest's Campground Status table 'Max Spur 25’' for Willow Creek. Recorded 40 (campground page). Both are over 23 ft, so no criteria problem, but expect tight spurs.
Count conflict: campground page '32 non-electric sites'; status table '35, single'. Recorded 32.

Dam access: no FS page read says anything about the road over the dam, its width, or RVs/trailers on it. The FS directions are only 'six miles northwest of Granby on US Highway 34, then three miles west on County Road 40 (on Willow Creek Reservoir)'. The note's 'Narrow single-lane dam access' is kept as the author's caveat (unsourced). No ARP road-status or closure entry names CR 40 or the campground.

Pin 40.14185,-105.95395 (= FS coordinates) is on the access road ~200 m SW of the campground loop (the loop centre is ~40.1432,-105.9520; recreation.gov puts the group site at 40.14250,-105.95306). Under the ~500 m threshold; could move to ~40.1432,-105.9520.

Waterfront (stored lakefront, NOT confirmed - re-audit lead): on NAIP (0.27 m/px, reservoir at or near full pool) the north ends of the site spurs are ~45-50 m from the shoreline through continuous lodgepole; no site reaches the water. The open ground by the shore at the NW tip is the boat ramp/day-use area, not campsites. Lakeview through the trees at most; not lakefront on this imagery (no per-site coordinates exist).
